title: SkillSwap
description: SkillSwap is a full-stack freelance marketplace where clients post small tasks like designing a logo, writing an article, or fixing a bug — and freelancers browse, apply, and get hired to complete them. Think of it as a streamlined, one-time-job version of Fiverr or Freelancer.com.

title: CourtHive
description: CourtHive is a full-stack web application that allows users to browse, list, and book sports courts — including futsal, badminton, and cricket. Whether you're looking to book a court for a quick match or want to earn by listing your own facility, CourtHive makes it seamless.

title: Modern AI Shop
description: Modern AI Shop is a full-stack e-commerce platform for discovering futuristic gadgets across a range of categories, complete with detailed product listings, images, and pricing. It's powered by two AI features: an AI Spec Generator that instantly drafts complete product listings from a short concept description, and a site-wide AI Chat Assistant that helps users navigate the platform and answer product questions in real time — no login required.
